result.topic_en: Notes on Riemann's 1860 shock-wave (Verdichtungsstoss) problem: an integral formula for w in the characteristic variables p, q, the case distinctions for initial data with two constant states, the jump conditions (mass and momentum balance) across a discontinuity, and shock speeds for advancing and receding compression shocks.
result.transcription:
$w_{p',q'} = (vw)_{q',s'} + \int_{q',s'}^{p',s'} v\left(w + \frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right) dp + w [-\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}-] \left(v + \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right) dq$
$= (vw)_{p',s'} + \int_{q',s'}^{p',s'} w\left(v - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p}\right) dp + v\left(w - \frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right) dq$
$\partial w$

1) $a \log \varrho = u - 4aq_2$, zu einem größeren Werthe von $a+u$ gehört ein größeres $\varrho$
2) $a \log \varrho = 4ap_1 - u$ $\quad$ " $\quad a-u$
$\quad 4ap = u + a\log\varrho \quad 4aq = u - a\log\varrho$
$\varrho_1 v_1 \varrho_1 [?] = \varrho_2 v_2 \partial t$
$aa(\varrho_1 - \varrho_2)\partial t = \varrho_1 v_1 (v_2 - v_1)\partial t$
$= \varrho_1 v_1^2 \left(\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2} - 1\right)\partial t$
$v_1 = \pm a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial t} - u_1$
$v_2 = \pm a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial t} - u_2$
